subject: Business Models
title: Netflix: DVD to Streaming
description: A micro-lesson that makes Netflix: DVD to Streaming usable.

hook.text: Netflix mailed DVDs in red envelopes. Then it bet the company on streaming and killed its own DVD business.

buildup.text: In 2007, Netflix launched streaming alongside DVD rental. Customers could do both for one price.

discovery.text: Netflix split the services and raised prices in 2011. It lost 800,000 subscribers in one quarter. Wall Street panicked.

twist.text: CEO Reed Hastings held firm. By 2013 Netflix was producing original content. By 2020 it had 200 million subscribers.

climax.text: Netflix cannibalized its own profitable model to build a bigger one. DVDs died, streaming became a $30B business.

punchline.text: Killed its own DVD business. Built a $30B streaming empire. Disruption wins.

quiz.question: How many subscribers did Netflix lose when it split DVDs and streaming?
